Record Class ModifyOrderRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.working.ModifyOrderRequest
Record Components:
quantity - the new whole-share quantity
limitPrice - the new limit price
stopPrice - the new stop price
trailAmount - the new trail in dollars; replaces a percent trail
trailPercent - the new trail in percent; replaces a dollar trail
timeInForce - DAY or GTC; a change restarts the time the order may work for
public record ModifyOrderRequest(@Min(value=1L,message="quantity must be at least 1 whole share") Long quantity, @Positive(message="limitPrice must be greater than zero") @Digits(integer=12,fraction=2,message="limitPrice may have at most two decimal places") BigDecimal limitPrice, @Positive(message="stopPrice must be greater than zero") @Digits(integer=12,fraction=2,message="stopPrice may have at most two decimal places") BigDecimal stopPrice, @Positive(message="trailAmount must be greater than zero") @Digits(integer=12,fraction=2,message="trailAmount may have at most two decimal places") BigDecimal trailAmount, @DecimalMin(value="0.10",message="trailPercent must be between 0.1 and 50") @DecimalMax(value="50.00",message="trailPercent must be between 0.1 and 50") @Digits(integer=2,fraction=2,message="trailPercent may have at most two decimal places") BigDecimal trailPercent, Order.TimeInForce timeInForce) extends Record
An edit to an OPEN order. Only the fields given change; each must apply to the order's type (a limit price to LIMIT and STOP_LIMIT, a stop price to STOP and STOP_LIMIT, a trail to TRAILING_STOP). The order keeps its ID and place in history.
